                     ADVANCE RELEASE CALENDAR (2026-27)
              Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
                                Government of India
   The Advance Release Calendar of MoSPI lays down the list of all the data
   releases/reports/publications of MoSPI scheduled during the year 2026-27 and includes
   planned dates for publishing/release of macro-economic indicators viz. GDP, IIP and CPI,
